تبتدعون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِعُونَ (tabtadiʕūna) /tab.ta.di.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# تُبْتَدَعُونَ (tubtadaʕūna) /tub.ta.da.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
